compiler_boundary.memory_operations: v8 buffer.load/store u8 only; exact output_lines read_word/write_word helper bytes

entry.return: u32; namespaced B3 bridge must preserve it as the complete u64 result

caller_preconditions: Separate live non-overlapping source, output and workspace extents for the whole synchronous call.
Caller serializes the returned state exactly; the numeric frame is not authenticated history or an authority token.
The u64 lengths/costs are exact 64-bit usize values of the original host algorithm. No strings, credentials, media values or pointers are serialized.
Output capacity may exceed 88; only its first 88 bytes are written on success. Workspace is neither read nor written.
Callbacks and actual truncate_text remain host-owned and happen in original per-item order. No upfront metadata pass, retry, batched callback or fallback decision engine.

item_kinds.0: Text: value is original UTF-8 byte length
item_kinds.1: Audio: value is the immediately preceding original callback token estimate
item_kinds.2: Image: value must be canonical zero
item_kinds.3: Encrypted: value must be canonical zero

state_invariants: Item and Finish require Ready; Snippet requires AwaitSnippet. Finished and unknown phases reject every non-Init operation.
omitted_audio_items <= processed_items - omitted_text_items; subtraction is evaluated only after the preceding bound.
Item and Snippet require processed_items < total_items.

output.operand: Truncate returns the unchanged positive remaining_budget; all other actions return zero.

transitions.Init: Return [1,Ready,mode,budget,budget,total,0,0,0,Init,0]. No allocation or text-size limit. Budget and total may be any u64.
transitions.Item.Text.zero_budget: Omit even empty text, increment text omission and processed once; do not calculate cost or request a snippet.
transitions.Item.Text.cost: Bytes cost=value. Tokens cost=floor(saturating_u64_add(value,3)/4), exactly the original 64-bit approx_token_count rule, not a mathematical unbounded ceil.
transitions.Item.Text.fits: If cost <= remaining, subtract cost; Keep and increment processed once. Empty text is kept when remaining is positive.
transitions.Item.Text.too_large: Set AwaitSnippet, return Truncate and the unchanged remaining operand. Do not increment processed or omission counters yet.
transitions.Snippet: Actual snippet length zero gives Omit plus one text omission; any positive u64 length gives Keep. Set remaining=0, Ready, and increment processed once. Do not charge, clip, inspect or retruncate the snippet; the original marker may exceed the original budget.
transitions.Item.Audio.cost: Rust invokes the original callback once at this item, including zero budget. Tokens cost=value; Bytes cost=saturating_u64_mul(value,4).
transitions.Item.Audio.fits: cost <= remaining gives Keep and subtracts cost; zero cost can Keep at zero remaining. Increment processed once.
transitions.Item.Audio.too_large: Omit and increment audio omission plus processed once; remaining is unchanged.
transitions.Item.Image_or_Encrypted: Require value==0, Keep, increment processed once, leave remaining and omission counters unchanged.
transitions.Finish: At Ready with every item processed, set Finished, action Finish, operand zero. Preserve the two omission counts; Rust appends the original text summary before the original audio summary.

rejection_precedence: Source length outside {40,80,88,96}: INVALID before any source read or output-capacity decision.
Admissible source length but capacity <88: SHORT_OUTPUT, even when later opcode/header fields are malformed.
Opcode outside {0,1,2,3} or exact opcode/frame-size mismatch: INVALID.
Version, mode and event-specific phase: INVALID.
Remaining/processed/text bounds, then the subtraction-based audio bound, then initial-state remaining bound: INVALID.
Finish count equality or Item/Snippet processed<total; Snippet positive remaining; Item kind and opaque canonical value: INVALID.
overflow_proof: All costs preserve the original saturating arithmetic. Cost saturation is valid input, not an overflow error.
After processed<total<=MAX, processed+1 is representable. Since each omission counter<=processed, its at-most-one increment is also representable.
text<=processed is established before processed-text. cost<=remaining is established before remaining-cost.
Forged counts that could overflow are rejected by these bounds before arithmetic or stores; INVALID is the only malformed/forged-overflow result.
read_word/write_word indexes advance only 0..7 within prechecked fixed frames/result. No source size is used as a numeric text or collection bound.

memory_and_interruption.store_order: Commit writes the 11 result words in offset order 0,8,...,80; each exact helper writes its eight bytes low to high.
memory_and_interruption.returned_error_atomicity: Every normal INVALID or SHORT_OUTPUT return precedes every output store.
memory_and_interruption.not_claimed: Fuel exhaustion, trap, process cancellation or external interruption during commit may expose a partially written prefix. No transactional cancellation or fuel/trace equivalence is claimed.

native_abi_layer.return_u64: Must exactly equal a stated Core u32 result. Nonzero upper 32 bits are wrapper rejection, never masked into a successful/invalid Core observation.
native_abi_layer.admission: Only separately admitted full-native31 B3 namespaced builds; full31_manifest_verified true and module_count 31. Old full-native30/seed-direct receipts cannot admit the new kernel.

host_boundary: Original item enum/order/content cloning and image/encrypted fields remain unchanged.
Per-audio callback interleaving, count and possible side effects remain host-owned.
The original truncate_text executes once only after Truncate, with exact remaining policy; Snippet records its byte length without changing its bytes.
Original summary text and text-before-audio summary order remain unchanged.
The all-text formatted helper and original truncate_text are not migrated by this kernel.
